title: auth-svc 503 cascade — payment-svc authorization unavailable
description: auth-svc deployment scaled to 0 pods at 16:00Z due to misconfigured HPA (minReplicas accidentally set to 0). payment-svc Feign client received 503/ConnectionRefused on all token validation calls. CircuitBreaker opened after 10 failures. All POST /v1/payments returned 503 for 8 minutes. Fix: restore auth-svc minReplicas=2.

title: Implement auth-svc fallback — allow cached token validation during outage
description: payment-svc has no fallback when auth-svc is unavailable. Add short-lived JWT cache (TTL=60s) so recently validated tokens can be accepted during brief auth-svc outages. Also fix HPA minReplicas guard: add admission webhook rejecting minReplicas=0 for tier-1 services.
